notes: Keeps the `fix` script and the lefthook pre-commit hook that runs it, which the application had before adopting recipes.
Keeps the `~/*` path alias in `tsconfig.json`, which every application module imports through.
`allowBuilds` also lists `lefthook: true` for its git hook install, `workerd: true` for Wrangler, `core-js: true`, and `protobufjs: false`, which the dependency tree pulls in.
`.oxlintrc.json` turns off `import/default`, which cannot see the default export of Vite `?worker` imports, and `react/no-array-index-key`, because palette and match lists can repeat a hex value.
